metadata.title: Gami Spectra USDC
metadata.description: Gami's Spectra USDC vault is a MetaVault curated by Gami Labs, designed to optimize stablecoin yields exclusively within the Spectra ecosystem through advanced positions on USD-pegged assets. Assets are supplied on the Base Network, though the vault retains the agility to deploy liquidity cross-chain to capture top-performing Spectra pools.
